Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 15:05:00 +0000
Subject: Change of invoicing address - all Riverholt contracts

Dear supplier,

From 1 November 2026 Riverholt Housing Association is moving to a single purchase ledger team. Please send all invoices for both your contracts with us - the Marsh View Estate redecoration and the void property programme - to invoices@riverholt-ha.example instead of this address.

Invoices must quote our order or works order number, or they will be returned. Payment terms are unchanged.

Kind regards,
Natalie Okafor
Accounts Payable, Riverholt Housing Association
